hero.source: Canine Distemper Virus Cytoplasmic Inclusion Body (Blood smear, Wright's stain)
hero.description: Canine Distemper virus cytoplasmic inclusion body within a neutrophil (blood smear, Wright's Stain). This was found on the blood smear of a 1-month-old, female, mixed breed puppy that presented with signs consistent with upper respiratory disease and conjunctivitis.  Diagnostics revealed that the dog had leukocytosis (23,200 WBCs/ul), anemia (PCV 22.2%), and hypoproteinemia (total protein 5.4 g/dl).
